newsitem.title: USA: MassElectric now reports 77,000 without power.
newsitem.headline: MassElectric now reports 77,000 without power.

text.p: MassElectric, a subsidiary of New England Electric System said Monday that 77,000 customers remained without power.
"Most of the outages are in the Merrimack Valley area. The town of Chelmsford, Billerica and the central Lawrence area," said MassElectric spokeswoman Mary Akyllas said.
The utility has brought in crews from Pennsylvania, New York, New Jersey and Quebec to help restore power to both residential and commercial customers.

"The problem is there are lots of small feeder lines out. It was raining trees and tree limbs and it takes time to cut the trees and restring the lines," said Akyllas. She added that the utility expects to work through Tuesday to restore power to all of its customers.

A vicious snowstorm that dumped up to 18-inches of heavy wet snow Saturday night left up to 500,000 utility customers in New England without power at one point during the weekend, emergency management agency officials said. Scores of school districts remained closed on Monday.
The storm was also blamed for at least one death in Connecticut when a firefighter stepped on a live downed power line.
